title: Affine power sections at points belonging to a unique component
statement: Let X be a reduced Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] [pqf-def-locnoeth] [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] [def-pc-reduced-scheme], and C_a → X (a in Fin r) distinct reduced closed subschemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] with ranges irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components] covering X. Let L be an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module] whose tensor pullback to each C_a [def-pc-module-pullback] is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. For any x in X lying on exactly one C_a there are n>0, s in Gamma(X,L^n), and an affine open U containing x equal to the nonvanishing locus of s. This makes no assertion at points belonging to two components.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 09NX, proof final paragraph (steps 5-7 of lem-sc-reduced-dim-le-one-ample), and Remark 09NW; Properties 01Q3 and 01PV

proof.text: Choose the unique component a containing x and a lift y. Construct the finite union T of all other component ranges as a closed subset, its vanishing ideal I, the concrete reduced subscheme Z=I.subscheme, and j=I.subschemeι. The range of j equals T. Uniqueness puts x outside T. support_comap and support_ker identify the support of j.ker.comap (i a) with the preimage of T, putting y outside it.

Apply exists_ample_pullback_ideal_affine_section to i a, L and j.ker.comap (i a), using the ample invertible pullback supplied by hL a. Obtain n>0, an ideal-supported section v and an affine nonvanishing open V containing y and disjoint from the pulled-back ideal support.

Apply conductor_sections to the concrete reduced cover and v. Its unique extension provides a section s of L^n zero on Z, and its locus equality identifies X_s with i a(V). The cover hypothesis gives range(i a) union T=X, and support_comap/support_ker transfer disjointness of V with the pulled-back support to disjointness of i a(V) with T. Apply exists_affineOpen_image_away_closed_cover to produce an affine open U=i a(V); the lift y and i a y=x prove x belongs to U. Combine the carrier equalities.

lean.statement: theorem exists_component_supported_affine_section (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X] [IsReduced X] (r : ℕ) (C : Fin r → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ a, C a ⟶ X) [∀ a, IsReduced (C a)] [∀ a, IsClosedImmersion (i a)] (hcomponents : ∀ a, Set.range (i a) ∈ irreducibleComponents X) (hdistinct : Function.Injective fun a ↦ Set.range (i a)) (hcover : (⋃ a, Set.range (i a)) = Set.univ) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hL : ∀ a, ∃ h : ((tensorPullback (i a)).obj L).IsInvertible, @IsAmple (C a) ((tensorPullback (i a)).obj L) h) (x : X) (hx : ∃! a, x ∈ Set.range (i a)) : ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ s : (L.tensorPow n).val.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤), ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧ (U : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow n) s
